true_answer: 0.3. Sets 27 We already have a lot of notation, and there is more yet. Below is a handy chart of symbols. Some of these will be discussed in greater detail as we move forward. Special sets. ∅ The empty set is the set which contains no elements. U The universe set is the set of all elements. N The set of natural numbers. That is, N | { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 ... } . Z The set of integers. That is, Z | { ..., − 2 , − 1 , 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 ,... } . Q The set of rational numbers. R The set of real numbers. P( A ) The power set of any set A is the set of all subsets of A . Set Theory Notation.
